parties: Avtar Steel Limited (issuer); Systematix Corporate Services Limited & Elara Capital (India) Private Limited (BRLMs); Promoter Sumit Jindal (OFS)
headline: Avtar Steel (stainless-steel long & wire maker) files ₹585-cr DRHP with SEBI for IPO combining fresh issue and OFS by promoter Sumit Jindal.
sum: Avtar Steel, a Delhi-headquartered specialty stainless-steel manufacturer with 30+ years operating history, filed DRHP on 14 August 2026 for a ₹585-crore IPO (book-built fresh issue + promoter OFS of 50 lakh shares). Proceeds earmarked for new Specialty Steel Melting Division capex, wire capacity expansion, debt repayment, and general corporate purposes; to list on BSE and NSE.
implication: Pre-IPO placement window (up to 20% of fresh issue, or ₹117 cr) permitted under ICDR Regulations 2018 Regulation 42; promoter-only cap table transition to public markets in specialty metals segment highlights strategic reliance on defensive manufacturing (defence/aerospace alloys) and sticky customer base (86% repeat customers in FY26) as listing thesis.
detail: Avtar Steel manufactures stainless-steel long and wire products across 150+ grades, including alloys for defence and aerospace. FY26 revenue was ₹1,263.3 crore (vs. ₹1,102.6 crore FY24); PAT nearly tripled to ₹59.1 crore; EBITDA margins expanded to 8.94%. Promoter Sumit Jindal holds 78% pre-IPO; family-held cap table with no institutional or PE seller. Book-built issue; equity to list on BSE and NSE. BRLMs: Systematix Corporate Services and Elara Capital (India); registrar: KFin Technologies.

framework.note: Core gateway rules for IPO eligibility, DRHP filing, merchant banker appointment, retail allocation; Regulation 42 permits pre-IPO placement up to 20% of fresh issue.
RHP filing, pre-issue advertising, IPO open date (min. 3 working days post-RHP filing), subscription period (3–10 working days).

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (as amended)
framework.note: Post-listing corporate governance, continuous disclosure, material event reporting by issuer and promoter.
Restricts promoter and insider trading; disclosure of promoter transactions within 24 hours of DRHP through issue closure.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Applicable post-listing if acquirer breaches 25% open-offer threshold.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 (Section 26 et seq., Prospectus rules)
framework.note: Incorporation, share capital, prospectus filing with Registrar of Companies (RoC), statutory auditor certification of funds utilization (if working capital > ₹5 cr).
Format and content of DRHP/RHP, public communications, and pre-issue advertisements.

framework.ref: BSE and NSE Listing Rules (unified norms)
framework.note: Exchange-specific listing requirements, listing timeline, corporate action compliance post-listing.

structure.consideration: ₹585 crore (fresh issue); OFS size dependent on share price; total IPO size and price band to be disclosed in RHP (Red Herring Prospectus)
conditions: Minimum subscription threshold (as per ICDR Regulations, typically 90% for book-built issues)
Completion of pre-issue advertising (2 working days before IPO opens)
Deposit of funds by successful bidders via ASBA mechanism
approvals: SEBI DRHP observations (filed 14 Aug 2026; status as of 19 Aug 2026: not yet publicly confirmed on SEBI website, though reported by business press)
Promoter and board approval for IPO and use of proceeds
structure.novel: Pre-IPO placement option (up to ₹117 crore, or 20% of fresh issue) disclosed in DRHP per ICDR Regulation 42; entirely promoter-held cap table (Jindal family) transitioning to public markets in specialty metals-no institutional or PE anchor pre-IPO.

triggers.note: DRHP filing triggers 30-day observation window; no merchant banker exemption; book-building mandatory for mainboard IPO.
Prospectus filing with RoC after issue closure; statutory auditor sign-off on capex/working capital utilization if amounts exceed prescribed thresholds.
Trading blackout enforced for promoters, officers, and entities aware of unpublished material information from DRHP filing through 48 hours post-listing; disclosures mandatory within 24 hours.
Listing compliance window (T+3 to T+5 post-allotment); lock-in periods for promoter and non-promoter shares (6 months); corporate governance board composition effective from listing date.
